supporting_observations.claim: FILE-HD-01 launched the CobaltVault backup agent as HARBOR-DENTAL\svc-bkp with a Nightly job targeting ingest.cobaltvault.net shortly before the alert time; the inventory identifies this agent and offsite backup service as approved.

The recorded CobaltVault proxy activity around that launch was small: the CONNECT reported 1,449 client-to-server bytes and 24,228 server-to-client bytes, followed by a GET; it does not show a transfer of hundreds of megabytes.

The agent process ended at 13:45:58.826 UTC, and a subsequent attempt to connect to the same endpoint received proxy status 407. These records do not establish that the alerted large transfer was performed by this agent.

The activity is temporally near an approved backup agent run, but the supplied records do not identify a large outbound flow, its destination, or its originating process. The alert therefore cannot be confirmed as either that backup or malicious exfiltration from these records.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show proxy requests and host network events, but do not provide a record of the alerted hundreds-of-megabytes transfer itself or its destination.
The recorded proxy byte counts concern the connections shown in T010-00322 and T010-00325; they do not establish whether other transfer telemetry captured the alert.
The supplied process records do not identify a process responsible for the alert-referenced transfer.
claims_not_established: Whether a hundreds-of-megabytes transfer actually occurred during the reviewed interval, and which destination received it.
Whether the alerted transfer was generated by CobaltVault, another process, or a different connection.
Whether the CobaltVault agent successfully uploaded backup data outside the small proxy activity recorded in T010-00322 through T010-00325.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the alert's underlying flow or sensor record, including exact timestamp, source and destination addresses, ports, protocol, byte counts, and any connection identifier.
Correlate proxy, firewall, and network-flow records for FILE-HD-01 around 13:46 UTC to identify the destination and confirm the transferred volume.
Collect process-to-network attribution and CobaltVault job/upload logs for the same period to determine whether the backup agent initiated the alerted flow.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: FILE-HD-01 proxy requests used GlobalProtect and Zscaler Client Connector user-agent strings; the inventory states there is no VPN and no other remote-access services are approved. These requests do not establish the source of the alerted transfer. Records: T010-00123, T010-00234, T010-00271, T010-00277.

Separate review: PROXY-HD-01 initiated an SMB connection to FILE-HD-01. The supplied records show the connection but do not explain its purpose; it is not linked to the alerted outbound transfer. Records: T010-00248, T010-00249, T010-00250, T010-00251.
